text:
Priya S.: hey team — last-minute ask: a small busker duo (2 ppl) will pop by at 4pm for a 20m acoustic demo in the lobby. theyre bringing a guitar, a small amp, and one flat pallet of merch (about 12 boxes). can we do temp badges + a short-term pallet drop near the loading dock? also one guest asked for a small fridge space for some homemade cookies that need to stay chilled until 4:10pm.
Sam (People Ops): sounds doable. we need a quick vendor COI for the merch if it's being delivered by a third party. do they have a company name? :guitar:
Priya S.: vendor listed as "StreetChord Collective" — they said merch is hand-carried but courier might show. i asked them to email a COI to ops@redwood. if courier shows up, please hold at dock.
Frontdesk Bot: Reminder: upload guest list to `visitor-uploads/`. Badge template available: `visitor-temp-v4.pdf`. Max temp badges per print job: 12. Delivery alert: pallet incoming? Please confirm carrier.
Jordan M.: i can meet the courier at 3:50 if needed. Malik, can facilities spare a pallet jack and a small staging area for ~30 mins?
Malik (Facilities): we can stage the pallet at dock B for up to 45 mins. pallet jack reserved. if they want the merch brought inside, it needs a sign-off from Sam. also amp under 50W ok per AV policy, no mains run.
Mailroom Bot: Delivery log: possible incoming pallet for "Priya S." — please provide sender name and tracking if available. If courier arrives, label items `MERCH-PRIYA-3160007777` and upload a photo to `mail-photos/`.
Sam (People Ops): checklist: 1) COI on file if courier used, 2) badges printed using `visitor-temp-v4.pdf`, 3) pallet staged at dock B with pallet jack, 4) cookies in pantry C fridge labeled `BUSKER_COOKIES-3160007777`, 5) amp within AV limits. Priya, can you confirm cookie fridge drop-off ETA?
Priya S.: cookies arriving with the duo at ~3:55pm (hand-carried). ill drop them in pantry C at 3:58 and label. Jordan  thanks for offering to meet the courier.
Malik (Facilities): quick seating note: moving the lobby bench frees up space for performance. i'll move bench to the east hall at 3:40. anyone needing the bench react with :hand:.
Jordan M.: no bench needed here. happy to escort and help with merch photo.
Frontdesk Bot: Badges printed at 3:59 using `visitor-temp-v4.pdf`. 2 badges ready in lobby tray. Delivery log will note pallet staging at Dock B if carrier arrives.
Sam (People Ops): great — final reminder: guests must be escorted while on-site, no unattended merch in common areas, and photograph packages on receipt. tagging this as done unless something changes. :white_check_mark:
Priya S.: thanks all! ill be at the lobby to greet them and handle sign-in. see you at 3:55. :raised_hands:
